help.title: Help
help.using_body: Sign in with your account. The left menu opens only the areas you are allowed to use. The header search finds scanners by code, serial number, or driver.
help.scanners_body: Scanners shows stock, status, branch, and the current driver. The Primary Manager adds new devices. Brand, model, serial number, and scanner phone number can be changed only with the identity right. The scanner phone number stays on the device and is not replaced by the employee's personal number when the device is assigned.
help.handover_body: Assign a scanner to a driver, take it over, or mark it returned, inactive, lost, or defective. Every handover stays in the history.
help.qr_body: Each scanner has its own QR link. The employee enters name and mobile number, confirms the SMS code, and accepts the device. Acceptance stays disabled until SMS is configured.
help.drivers_body: Manage driver and employee records under Drivers / Employees. A user account can also be created as an employee so scanners can be assigned.
help.permissions_body: The Primary Manager creates users with one role: Employee/Driver, Scanner Administrator, Administrator, or Super Administrator. Extra rights, such as identity fields, are granted only by the Primary Manager.
help.reports_body: Reports export stock, drivers, handovers, and loss records as CSV, Excel, or PDF. Export requires the matching permission.
help.faq_q1: Why can I not change brand or serial number?
help.faq_a1: Those fields are protected. Only the Primary Manager or a user she explicitly authorizes can change them.
help.faq_q2: Why does QR acceptance not work?
help.faq_a2: Acceptance needs a working SMS configuration. The Primary Manager enters the credentials in Settings.
help.support_body: Ask the Primary Manager about day-to-day use. Technical system details are listed below.
